title.zh: 体育馆原罪 vs 小酒馆酷感

summary.en: In rock, size is never just capacity. It's a moral argument with beer in it.
summary.zh: 在摇滚里，规模从来不只是人数。它是一场掺着啤酒的道德辩论。

body.en:
Club kids accuse arena acts of selling out. Arena acts accuse clubs of LARPing poverty with better leather. Both can be right on different nights.

Punk arrives as a subtraction machine for stadium excess. Britpop and later indie reclaim big rooms wearing different jackets. The fight isn't stupid—it protects something tender about proximity—but it gets stupid when volume becomes virtue. Listen for whether the songs still breathe when the room gets cathedral-sized.
body.zh:
小酒馆骂体育馆卖身。体育馆骂小酒馆穿着更好的皮衣玩穷。不同夜晚两边都可能对。

Punk 像一台给体育馆过剩做减法的机器。Britpop 和后来的 indie 又换件外套把大场地夺回来。这场架并不蠢——它护着某种关于「靠近」的娇气——但当音量变成品德，就蠢了。听歌在房间变成大教堂时，还喘不喘得上气。

note.en: Politics in a room that kept getting larger.
note.zh: 政治待在一个越来越大的房间里。
